newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Oct public deficit seen at 400 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Oct public deficit seen at 400 mln pesos.

text.p: Argentina's non-financial public sector deficit for October should be about 400 million pesos, said private analysts Wednesday, quoting what they said was official data due to be released this week.

They said that would take the deficit for the first 10 months of the year to 4.5 billion pesos. That means the last two months of 1996 would have to show a deficit of no more than 1.5 billion pesos to meet the 6.0 billion peso deficit target agreed with the International Monetary Fund.
"That goal is difficult to reach, but not impossible, especially if we consolidate economic recovery," said a private analyst who asked not to be named.
